title: HELIX Bridge: Handshake First Destination Survey → ContinuingEducation

source_objects.description: One row per graduate per survey: status, outcome, employer, continuing education, and knowledge source.
Graduates the survey was sent to, including non-responders. Needed for the knowledge rate.

notes: Handshake carries the institutional student ID from SSO or the student data feed. Resolve that ID to HELIX Student in the restricted identity zone; never match on name and email alone without steward review. Outcomes follow NACE First-Destination Standards: the class includes graduates from July 1 to June 30, and outcomes are measured up to six months after graduation.
validate: Column labels follow a typical Handshake First Destination Survey export; they change with survey configuration. VALIDATE against your own export. The same fields apply if your survey runs in Qualtrics, Symplicity, or GradLeaders.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from student ID + survey ID + school.
Resolve to the HELIX Degree the survey is about. Students with two degrees in one class get one survey per degree only if your office surveys that way.
NACE class year: July 1 to June 30. A May 2026 graduate is '2025-2026'.

Master's -> masters, Doctorate -> doctoral, JD -> professional_jd, MD/DO -> professional_md, other professional -> professional_other, second bachelor's -> second_bachelors, certificate -> certificate, post-bacc -> postbaccalaureate.
Match the school name to the IPEDS directory; null if no confident match.
CIP 2020 code if the survey captures it; else null.
